Synopsis:
Kalshi permanently banned former U.S. Congressman George Santos from its prediction market platform and fined him $71,356 for insider trading. The action reflects growing compliance pressures across prediction market platforms (Kalshi, Polymarket), as regulators and law enforcement increase scrutiny of the sector. Santos, previously expelled from Congress for fraud and identity theft, had been reported to the DOJ in June over suspicious trading activity.
